_comment: Copy to .agents/repo-map.config.json and adjust paths for your machine.
The real config is gitignored: paths are per-developer, not project facts.
exclude_dirs keeps a subtree out of the index. Its main use is excluding
the directory the session is opened in, which is readable with the file
tools already and does not need indexing.

spdk._why: Every lvstore/blobstore abort RCA starts here. Verified: 'Forcing application shutdown via abort' -> lib/lvol/lvol.c:2945; 'Extent page crc mismmatch' -> lib/blob/blobstore.c:5990.

ultra._why: The distrib layer. Verified: 'DISTRIBD Unable to read stripe' -> DISTR_v2/src_code_app_spdk/bdev_distrib/parts/alg_io_split_parity2.cpp:226.

operator._why: Contains the CSI driver, which owns the nvme connect string. Verified: ctrl_loss_tmo, keep-alive-tmo and fast_io_fail all resolve here, e.g. test/integration/controlplane/connect.go:159.

sbcli._why: The product code: simplyblock_core, simplyblock_web, simplyblock_cli. Needed because a session opened with e2e/ as its root cannot reach them with the file tools. e2e is excluded because it IS that root. Verified: 'port fence held {}s' -> simplyblock_core/storage_node_ops.py:10312; 'already shutting down in this cluster' -> :6900; 'NO LONGER leader' -> :10156.
